objective: Define the smallest boundary that lets a ready non-executing native-parser adapter-payload to sidecar plan-resolution result feed sidecar_handoff_contract metadata, while keeping runtime handoff execution, command synthesis, operator-plan production, measurement, timing, runtime/ABI, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, automatic allocation, upstream regression success, and upstream landing claims out of scope.

definition_decision.weakest_point: sidecar_handoff_contract is a metadata object, but its name can be over-read as runtime handoff execution or native Verilator correctness evidence. The boundary must therefore require a ready plan-resolution result and explicitly separate metadata construction from command synthesis, operator-plan production, execution, compare evidence, timing, runtime/ABI, arbitrary filelist expansion, and automatic allocation.
definition_decision.operator_goal: A later implementation may add a non-executing helper that consumes an already resolved ready plan-resolution object and returns sidecar_handoff_contract metadata using existing sidecar authorities, without expanding parser ownership or running anything.

not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim.expected_behavior: return or raise a structured not-ready result that preserves plan_resolution_readiness.not_ready_reason and missing_readiness_inputs

unsupported_for_stage_plan.expected_behavior: return or raise a structured unsupported result that preserves sidecar_stage_plan reason

required_tests_for_next_review_or_implem: ready plan-resolution preconditions require outer status ready_for_verilator_option_shim and ready_for_direct_verilator_option true
not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim plan-resolution outputs cannot produce handoff_contract metadata
unsupported_for_stage_plan outputs cannot produce handoff_contract metadata
future metadata helper checks stage_plan hybrid_sidecar_run and coverage_output_compare details before constructing handoff metadata
parser-owned schedule fields are used only as cross-checks and not as source closure, report path, compare label, or allocation authorities
command synthesis, operator plan, runtime handoff execution, RTL execution, compare execution, timing, and automatic allocation remain absent

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_sidecar_plan_resolution_handoff_contract_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether ready-only metadata construction is the correct next boundary after status hardening
whether the minimal field list is sufficient for sidecar_handoff_contract without parser inference of sidecar-owned fields
whether not-ready and unsupported plan-resolution outputs are blocked from producing handoff metadata
whether command synthesis, operator plan, execution, measurement, timing, runtime/ABI, arbitrary filelist expansion, and automatic allocation remain out of scope
must_not_claim: command synthesis from native parser payload
operator-plan production from native parser payload
coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow

non_claims: not a native Verilator parser implementation
not command synthesis from native parser payload
not operator-plan production from native parser payload
not coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow
not a new public CLI or workflow
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
not a runtime or ABI change
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
